data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Ron total 20, reducing to 2. Number 2 is associated with cooperation, sensitivity and balance.

in_greek.name: Ron
in_greek.meaning: Χριστιανικό όνομα που σημαίνει Strong one, powerful one
in_greek.long_meaning: Ron είναι ένα χριστιανικό όνομα με βαθιά πνευματική σημασία στον χριστιανικό πολιτισμό. The name Ron derives from the Hebrew language and originally meant ‘strong one, powerful one’. In the Bible, the name Ron is not directly used, but it is a derivative of the name Ronald, which has biblical connections. In the Old Testament, the name Ron is found in the list of the 48 names of the tribes of Israel.
